subject: Control System
questionText:
Consider the following statements regarding root
loci:
1.
All root loci start from the respective poles of
G(s)H(s).
2.
All root loci end at the respective zeros of
G(s)H(s) or go to infinity.
3.
The root loci are symmetrical about the
imaginary axis of the s-plane.
Of these statements: 
(a)
1, 2 and 3 are correct
(b)
1 and 2 are correct
(c)
2 and 3 are correct
explanation: Practice Question from Control System DPP-13 (Root Locus-(Part-01&02)).
